details.text: No registered surveyor's mid-span clearance survey data is provided documenting overhead conductor elevations and pole locations. When vertical clearance appears marginal, surveyor data is required but not submitted.

comments.summary: The site plan provides no clearance dimensions at all from overhead electric facilities to site features. When dimensions are absent, measurement origin (outside conductor vs. pole centerline) cannot be verified. Per UCM § 1.10.3, critical measurement must originate from outside conductor.
comments.attn: This is a foundational documentation gap affecting verification of nearly all other clearance items. All clearance dimension callouts must show measurement origin from the outside/outermost conductor, not from pole centerline.

details.text: Site plan sheets show no clearance dimension callouts originating from overhead electric conductor locations to any site features (buildings, structures, equipment, driveways, walls, fences). Complete absence of dimensions prevents verification that measurements originate from outside conductor per UCM § 1.10.3 requirement.

runComments.comment: Clearance dimensions required by code are not shown on site plan sheets. Where clearance dimensions are lacking, no verification can be performed that they extend from the outside conductor (not pole centerline or pole structure). The requirement that dimensions originate from the outer conductor, not pole center, cannot be verified when dimensions are absent.
No clearance dimensions shown on any plan sheets. Measurement methodology (from outside conductor vs. pole center) cannot be verified.

The site plan provides no clearance dimensions at all from any overhead electric facilities to site features. Where dimensions are absent, it is impossible to verify that they are measured from the outside conductor rather than from pole centerline. Per UCM § 1.10.3, the critical measurement point is the outside conductor, not the pole centerline. The plan's complete absence of clearance dimensions means this requirement cannot be evaluated.

comments.headline: Missing construction contractor notification and staging documentation
comments.summary: Site plan lacks required 48-hour Austin Energy notification note per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752. Construction staging areas with OSHA 10-foot and 20-foot radial clearance requirements also not documented. Pre-construction coordination missing.
comments.crossDep: Austin Energy coordination and contractor safety planning required during pre-construction phase.
comments.attn: Notification requirement is a legal mandate under Texas state law. Contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before any work begins near high-voltage OHE lines. OSHA clearance requirements during construction (20-foot) differ from permanent clearances.

details.text: Cover sheet (Sheet 1) and general notes (Sheet 3) do not include required note stating that owner/contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines. Required notification language per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003 is missing.

runComments.comment: Overhead electric lines exist on or adjacent to the site. No note is included on the cover sheet or general notes stating that owner/contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines, as required by Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003. This required notification note is missing from the plan set.

The cover sheet (Sheet 1) does not include a note requiring that the owner/contractor notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines, as required by Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003. While Sheet 3 (General Notes) contains comprehensive electric transmission notes, the specific 48-hour notification requirement is not explicitly stated on either the cover sheet or general notes sheets.

details.text: Construction staging areas and equipment operation zones not clearly identified on erosion control or construction phasing sheets. No plan view shows staging area boundaries with documented 10-foot radial clearance from energized OHE lines. OSHA 20-foot construction-phase clearance requirement not detailed separately.

runComments.comment: Erosion and sedimentation control plan (Sheet 5) may show staging areas, and electrical plan shows overhead lines on site boundaries. However, no site logistics plan or construction phasing plan explicitly identifies construction staging areas, crane swing radius, equipment laydown zones, or work platforms with 10-foot radial clearance verification from overhead lines. Cannot verify construction-phase clearance compliance.
Construction staging areas and equipment zones not detailed on site plan. OSHA 10-foot radial clearance requirement not documented.

Construction staging areas and equipment zones may be depicted on erosion control or construction phasing sheets, but no plan view clearly identifies staging area boundaries with documented 10-foot radial clearance from energized overhead electric lines. OSHA requires 20-foot clearance during construction, distinct from permanent clearances.
